months.3: Temperatures begin to rise, thawing the trails and making the walks along the restored walls more comfortable, though the air on the ridges can still be brisk. Spring dust storms can leave the air hazy and gritty on some days.
months.4: Spring brings mild temperatures and mostly clear skies, with excellent visibility across the mountain ridges on most days, though spring dust storms can leave the air hazy on some. Both the restored and wild sections are in peak condition for day hikes.
